notes.title: I posted the game tips.
notes.notes:
The rules are displayed at the beginning of the game, but the numbers do not move even if you press the elevator button at that time. Please take this as a time to memorize the environment. The game will start after you press the elevator button at that time.

There are a total of five anomalies that can be collected.

∙ When you see a child of black cloth, we recommend that you do not make contact with it.

notes.title: B1Playtest has been started.
notes.notes:
We have randomly selected participants from those who applied for the B1Playtest.

Those who were able to play should have received an invite to their email address registered on Steam!

If you have successfully found all the anomalies or bugs, it would be great if you could tell us about them via X (@toyasky_lake) or email address (toyaskygames@gmail.com)!

notes.title: I am looking for someone to participate in the SteamPlaytest!
notes.notes:
We are looking for people to participate in the SteamPlaytest!
We have uploaded the beta version of "B1". From now on, we are looking for people who can participate in the steamplaytest on the store page.

You can complete your application by "requesting participation" in the steamplaytest on the store page.

Please note that the selection of participants is completely random and not all applicants will be able to play the game.

You will be notified of the start of the beta test via your email address registered on Steam. As soon as you receive the email, it should be available from the library.

If you have any problems with progress or anything that you think is not right.
Please report any problems you encounter on the bulletin board or by e-mail (toyaskygames@gmail.com)!

The contents of this Playtest may not be transmitted in any form, such as video or broadcast.
We will not allow the contents of this Playtest to be transmitted in a form that can be viewed by a third party, regardless of the format, such as video, distribution, etc.

Please refrain from participating if you wish to purchase and enjoy the full version of the game, since the beta version is almost like the full version.
